mechanism: Moxifloxacin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of diazepam and both drugs have CNS depressant effects; moxifloxacin also carries QT prolongation risk which may be compounded by diazepam.
action: Monitor for increased diazepam effects (sedation, respiratory depression); consider dose reduction of diazepam or use alternative antibiotic; monitor ECG if cardiac risk factors present.
